note: An example for the layout in compose.example.yaml and nftables-model-host.example.nft. Replace every address with yours. Roles: admin = a machine that has internet access (it proves the outside is reachable); app = the host that runs the pipeline; workstation = where a person works; gateway; server = the reference server; model = the host the model runs on.

checks.why: only the pipeline reaches the gateway, so a person's machine cannot send a prompt of their own
the gateway reads the AI switch and data sheet from the reference server
the gateway reaches the model (through LiteLLM)
the pipeline cannot reach the model except through the gateway
nobody's machine reaches the model except through the gateway
the reference server holds shared work, not a way to the model
stand-in for the outside: shows an address that answers from a machine that is allowed out
the model host has no route to the internet: it cannot send a prompt, an answer or a log anywhere
the model host starts no connections into the network
the gateway talks to the server and the model and to nothing else
